title: Minimum Operations to Transform Array into Alternating Prime
summary: Given an integer array, determine the least number of increments needed to make it an alternating prime array.
statement: Given an integer array, determine the least number of increments needed to make it an alternating prime array. An element at an even index must be a prime number, and an element at an odd index must be a non-prime number. Each operation allows incrementing any element by one.
constraints: After increments, even indices must be prime and odd indices must be non-prime.
Return the minimum total one-unit increments.
hints: Indices are independent because incrementing one value does not affect another.
Test primality by trial division through the square root.
At each index, advance until primality matches the required parity pattern and add the distance.
The first qualifying value is the cheapest reachable value for that index, so summing independent minima is globally optimal.
